Arthur Beaumont has been rushing about in Italy but is as right as rain. Speaks in glowing terms of the welcome they get in the villages and the Italian girls.
Arthur Beaumont reminds us of the ardours of the Italian campaign, and is looking for a change when he returns to civil life. It is rumoured that he was married when on leave recently.
Arthur Beaumont has been doing all sorts of things in Italy. He has been on bricklaying courses and gunnery, and on the lighter side has done some ski-ing.

ARTHUR BEAUMONT writes from Italy: 'It's pouring down outside, you can hardly get your plates of meat out of the mud. I'll never look the five miles course at Wimbledon in the face again after all this mud'.
Arthur Beaumont says he is now in Tripoli for a rest after the big advance. Tells unusual tales about the Arabs and tent life.
